title: International Higher National Diploma In Law (Level 5)
description: The International Higher Diploma in Law (Level 5) empowers students with the legal expertise to navigate and excel in an ever-evolving global landscape.
longDescription: The purpose of the International Higher National Diploma in Law (Level 5) is to develop students professionally and personally, equipping them with the legal knowledge and critical thinking skills to meet the demands of the legal sector and thrive in an ever-changing global environment. This course enhances your ability to understand legal issues, analyze complex problems, and find effective solutions. It introduces you to fundamental legal concepts essential for understanding how law functions, ensuring that whether you pursue further education or enter the legal profession, you will stand out with a critically developed understanding of the key skills needed to excel in the legal field. This International Higher National Diploma in Law (Level 5) serves as a solid foundation for further legal education and opens up diverse career opportunities within the legal profession. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 120 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: Each module consists of 40 guided learning hours of material with an additional 30-50 hours worth of optional materials which comprise of recommended exercises, recommended readings and internet resources. Within the modules are self-testing exercises. You must take care in answering these. Although they are not marked nor do they count towards your final assessment, the marking is tested against your scoring on the final assessment to check for consistency of score. Successful completion of the full Level 5 Diploma in Law will equip students with the necessary credentials to pursue careers in legal practice, corporate law, legal consultancy, compliance, or public sector roles.

entry: For entry into Level 5 International Higher National Diploma in Law, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership, or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up On completion of this course, students have the opportunity to complete a Master degree programme from Girne American University. The top-up programme can be studied online or on campus. The top-up comprises the final 60 credits which consist of either a dissertation or a dissertation and one module. (The course tuition fee listed above does NOT include the top-up fee) University Progression Click here to see University routes and fee information for progression.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
